test_3_concurrent_reads.notes: During schema alteration mid-flight, 99/100 reads succeeded. 1 read failure (not downtime - just returned null). Latency p99 of 25ms shows minimal impact.

caveats: Test data created in namespace 1 (prefix 1-0-) while main dataset in namespace 0 (prefix 0-)
Query responses for test namespace show empty values despite data being stored (metrics confirm storage)
